HTML comment ending with ---> (three dashes) must not drop content that follows (issue #339)

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<h1>One</h1>\n<!-- /// --->\n<p>Two</p>");
  console.log(result);
}

void main();
```
